# Checked by .github/ci/compat-allowlist-check.py: one `Class#method` per line; a failure
# missing from this list, or an entry that no longer fails, fails the run. Delete an entry
# as soon as its test passes. Measured 2026-10-01 on main 231655b70 plus #4787, JVM image;
# failures that also occur in the commercial control run are environmental and not listed.
